_note: screens-round12-domain-case-cards, board DqAanbesteding: a bid carries the scores the assessors gave it, so the tender's Bids tab can show the assessment as the board draws it (price score, quality score, total, rank). The weighting itself belongs to the tender, not to a bid, and is not stored here. Version moves so an existing instance re-imports the schema.
